summary: Dwellings for students at university, college, other post-secondary education or adult education (PBL 1 kap. 4 §, definition since 1 July 2025). They are ordinary 'bostäder' under BFS 2024:11 with three relaxations: sizing may take into account that each student lives there for a limited time (2 kap. 2 §, 3 kap. 3 §), which allows smaller area, overlapping functions and shorter kitchen fittings; up to 80 % of the student dwellings in a building may be exempt from accessibility requirements but must be visitable (PBL 8 kap. 6 § p. 4, PBF 3 kap. 5 a-5 b §§); and the help space around a bed is not required (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 10 §). Two layouts: (a) self-contained studios with all functions inside (fire class 3A, normal dwelling sound rules); (b) corridor rooms ('boendeenheter' for one person, each with its own contract) sharing socialising, cooking (max 12 persons per kitchen) and meals, and optionally hygiene rooms (max 3 units per room, same floor). Layout (b) is fire class 3B (stove guards required, compartment per group of at most 6 persons unless sprinklered) and has its own sound table (BFS 2024:10 2 kap. 4 §). The old BBR 3:225 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) band (student dwellings <=35 m²) and its fixed kitchen and storage advice no longer exist.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: Studios: 3A (BFS 2024:7, 2 kap. 14 §). Corridor units with shared functions: 3B — 'bostäder med boendeenheter' (2 kap. 15 §), with stove guards on resident cookers (4 kap. 25 §) and a fire compartment per group of units for at most 6 persons incl. their common room, or each unit its own compartment unless the group is sprinklered (5 kap. 25 § p. 4 and 6).

permits: Bygglov for change of use: PBL 9 kap. 15 § p. 1-2 (as amended by Lag 2025:974).

The application should state clearly that it is for student housing. Later changing from student to ordinary housing is a change of use that triggers the ordinary-dwelling requirements, even though it needs no permit (archived Boverket guidance, p. 14).
The builder chooses whether the 20 % accessible share is counted on all student dwellings in the building or only on those added by the measure (Boverket guidance on PBL 8 kap. 6 §).
regulatory.operator_oversight: Byggnadsnämnden. Operators are typically student housing companies; no state licensing.

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Working value. Boverket's archived BBR guidance says a student dwelling with all functions inside 'kan få en boarea på som minst cirka 16 m2'; corridor units are smaller but add shared kitchens. Gross-up for shared rooms, circulation and walls is an assumption.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Indicative term-time weekday profile; not sourced. Seasonal vacancy in summer (June-August) can bring average presence well below term values.
occupancy.persons_per_dwelling_note: 1 person per studio or corridor unit (design). Double studios for couples exist; they count as 2.

spaces.label_sv: Studentlägenhet / studentetta med eget kök och hygienrum

required.basis: PBF 3 kap. 1 § and 17 § (all six bostadsfunktioner); BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 1-3 §§ (hygiene room inside), 3 kap. 1 § and 3 § (fixed fittings for hygiene and cooking; for students sized considering the limited stay)

size.source: No m² in law. The 16 m² lower end is from Boverket's archived guidance on old BBR 3:225 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) ('som minst cirka 16 m2'). 22 m² and the 28 m² upper end are working values carried over from data/standards/space_requirements.json.

spaces.notes: Overlapping functions (e.g. sofa bed with table for socialising, sleep and meals) are explicitly allowed (Boverket studentbostäder guidance). Daylight DF >= 1.0 % over half the habitable area (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 1 §; 0.8 % possible on conversion, 13 kap. 5 §). The old 'no direct sunlight needed' rule (BBR 6:323 (repealed BBR, pre-2025)) is gone; we found no direct-sunlight requirement in BFS 2024:8. Sound: same as other dwellings (BFS 2024:10 2 kap. 2 §).

spaces.label_en: Corridor unit (private room, boendeenhet for one person)

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 1 kap. 5 § (boendeenhet = part of a dwelling let for private use where some functions are shared) and 2 kap. 7-8 §§. Boverket: each unit needs its own tenancy contract; if several students rent together on one contract, the rooms are not boendeenheter and the whole flat is one dwelling.

size.source: Working value from data/standards/space_requirements.json; no source sets size.

spaces.notes: Daylight requirement applies both in the unit and in the rooms for shared functions (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 1 § second paragraph). Sound between units in a student corridor: DnT,w,100 >= 48 dB; from the internal corridor 40 dB; from shared rooms 44 dB (BFS 2024:10 table 2:3). Each unit may have its own private shower/WC (most common) or share per student_shared_hygiene.

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 7 § (cooking may be shared by units for one person, adjacent to the units, sized for the number sharing; 'Bostadsfunktionen matlagning får delas av högst tolv personer') and 3 kap. 4 § (fixed fittings sized for those sharing). Stove guard on cookers: BFS 2024:7 4 kap. 25 §.

size.source: Regulation caps the group at 12 but sets no m². data/standards/space_requirements.json uses 2.5 m² per resident for kitchen plus social space (indicative, unsourced).

spaces.shareable_note: Must be in connection with the units ('i anslutning till'); Boverket accepts another floor only with internal communication that does not pass through public stairwells.
spaces.notes: A unit may have its own kitchenette and also share a kitchen (Boverket boendeenheter guidance).

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 7 § (socialising and meals may be shared, adjacent, sized for the number sharing). The shared space must compensate for smaller private rooms; Boverket mentions a lounge or common room for several units.

size.count: sized 'lämpliga för det antal personer som delar dem'
size.source: Boverket: 'Reglerna anger inte hur de delade utrymmena ska se ut eller hur stora de måste vara.'

spaces.notes: DF requirement applies to rooms for shared functions (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 1 §), but the outlook requirement does not apply to shared socialising and meal spaces in dwellings with one-person units (4 kap. 2 § second paragraph). So it needs daylight but not necessarily a view; a toplit interior room may work.

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 8 §: if shared, at most three one-person units per hygiene room, adjacent to and on the same floor as the units. Boverket: reachable without passing through other residents' private areas or public stairwells/galleries.

spaces.notes: Sharing cuts the number of wet rooms per resident by up to two thirds, a big lever in office conversion, but it lowers lettability.

spaces.label_en: Accessible WC for visitors (when units are exempt from accessibility)

required.basis: PBF 3 kap. 5 a § p. 3 / 19 a § p. 3: a student dwelling that only needs to be visitable must have at least one accessible WC for the visitor in the building near the dwelling; also the visitor must reach the floor and enter, and there must be a space for socialising with the visitor

size.count: at least one per building, near the exempted dwellings
size.source: No m²; accessibility dimensions per BFS 2024:12 1 kap. 6 §.

spaces.notes: Only needed if the 80 % exemption is used. At least 20 % of the student dwellings stay fully accessible. If those accessible ones cannot be reached from the ground, all exempted dwellings must be visitable (PBF 3 kap. 5 b §).

required.basis: Not required by law; common operator practice.

spaces.shareable_note: Could be a co-working space shared with other residents.
spaces.notes: Fits the deep, windowless zone of an office plan. If people stay more than temporarily it is a 'lokal' room under BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 § (enough daylight 'unless unreasonable for the intended use').

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 4 § and 3 kap. 2 § (as for housing_apartment)

size.count: sized for the dwellings sharing it

spaces.label_sv: Förråd (förvaring som inte är för dagligt bruk)

required.basis: BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 5 § (may be outside the dwelling, near it, and separated)

size.source: No m² in regulation. The old BBR 3:225 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) general advice gave storage measures for small student dwellings; they are no longer in force and were not retrieved.

spaces.notes: Limited stay (2 kap. 2 §) may justify smaller storage.

required.basis: BFS 2026:4 2 kap. 2 § (>= 2 per apartment in a new flerbostadshus; may be adapted to local conditions, especially if the building mainly contains dwellings for one person). On alteration only for ombyggnad involving car parking (1 kap. 4 §).

size.count: law default 2 per apartment; adaptation allowed for one-person dwellings

spaces.notes: Students cycle a lot. Even where the rule allows fewer, operators and municipalities usually want generous bicycle parking.

required.basis: PBL 8 kap. 9 § second paragraph and 10 § (applies to all plots with dwellings, student housing included)

BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 1-5 §§; PBF 3 kap. 4 §; for exempted student dwellings, visitability means the visitor can reach the floor (lift if three or more storeys), with special rules for two-storey buildings (PBF 3 kap. 5 b §)

size.source: Lift short side >= 1100 mm (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 5 §); otherwise functional.

spaces.notes: Internal corridors inside a corridor dwelling are part of the dwelling, not public circulation.

variants.label: Studios with own kitchen and bathroom
variants.changes: All functions inside each unit; Vk 3A; sound per BFS 2024:10 table 2:1 (normal dwellings); one wet room and one kitchenette per resident. Gross about 28-38 m² per resident (indicative).

variants.label: Corridor rooms with shared kitchen
variants.changes: Boendeenheter for one person (individual contracts). Shared kitchen <= 12 persons, shared living/dining; optional shared hygiene <= 3 units per room on the same floor. Vk 3B with stove guards and compartment per group of <= 6 persons or sprinkler. Sound table 2:3. Gross about 22-30 m² per resident (indicative).

typical_blockers: Daylight DF >= 1.0 % in each unit AND in the shared kitchen/living rooms (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 1 §); 0.8 % only with justification on conversion (13 kap. 5 §).
Wet rooms per unit (studios) and their drainage through existing slabs.
Fire class 3B for corridor layouts: compartment per group of at most 6 persons, or sprinklers (BFS 2024:7 5 kap. 25 §).
Facade length per resident: many small rooms each need a window.
typical_enablers: Deep plans: the 'utblick' requirement does not apply to shared socialising and meal rooms for one-person units (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 2 §), so these can sit deeper (daylight factor still applies).
Shared hygiene rooms (<= 3 units each) cut wet rooms.
Accessibility relief: up to 80 % of units exempt (PBL 8 kap. 6 §), no bed help-space requirement (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 10 §).
Limited-stay sizing (BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 2 §) allows small units and short kitchen fittings.

Boverket's archived guidance on old BBR 3:52 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) already accepted relaxations when converting deep buildings with load-bearing interior walls into student housing or one-person housing with shared spaces; BFS 2024:11 4 kap. 1 § carries similar adaptation grounds.

open_questions: No current source gives m² for studios, corridor rooms or shared kitchens. Collect actual programmes from operators (e.g. AF Bostäder, SGS Studentbostäder, Uppsala studentbostäder) or Studentbostadsföretagen to replace the indicative values.
Does the student sound table (BFS 2024:10 table 2:3) also apply between corridor units when shared hygiene is used? (Assumed yes.)
Boverket's student guidance mentions a separate page on noise protection for student housing (skydd-mot-buller/bostader/studentbostader); it was not read in detail.

Old BBR 3:225 (repealed BBR, pre-2025) general advice had minimum kitchen fitting length and storage for student dwellings <=35 m². Under BFS 2024:11 there is no replacement figure. Check whether Boverket guidance or SS 91 42 21 revisions supply one.
PBL 8 kap. 6 § wording changes on 1 Jan 2027 (Lag 2026:746: units in attics or suterräng need not be visitable). Re-check.
Summer vacancy profile: no source used. Operator data would improve the hourly and seasonal presence.
